verdict.rationale: Intuit's developer docs offer a QuickBooks Workforce API reference covering schema, GraphQL, OAuth and webhooks, with samples, worked examples, testing guidance and an automatic sandbox company. Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or examples that run in the browser, and no OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404). Missing for 10: an evidenced interactive API explorer, runnable in-docs examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
